title: confiture install-helpers --format json
description: What installing the view-dependency helpers did: installed them, found them already installed (without --force), or — with --dry-run — would run the SQL it carries. A configuration or connection failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

oneOf.description: The helpers were created (`installed`), or were present and --force was not given (`already_installed`).

schema.description: The schema the helpers live in.

functions.description: The helper functions, as signatures: `confiture.save_and_drop_dependent_views(schemas TEXT[])` and `confiture.recreate_saved_views()`.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.

oneOf.description: --dry-run: nothing was executed; `sql` is what would be.

schema.description: The schema the helpers live in.
